name: ttv-lol-pro
description: TTV LOL PRO removes most livestream ads from Twitch.
author: Younes Aassila (https://github.com/younesaassila)

scripts.clean: shx rm -rf .parcel-cache ; shx rm -rf dist ; shx --silent rm src/manifest.json ; exit 0
scripts.predev:firefox: npm run clean && shx cp src/manifest.firefox.json src/manifest.json
scripts.predev:chromium: npm run clean && shx cp src/manifest.chromium.json src/manifest.json
scripts.prebuild:firefox: npm run clean && shx cp src/manifest.firefox.json src/manifest.json
scripts.prebuild:chromium: npm run clean && shx cp src/manifest.chromium.json src/manifest.json
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && tar -caf v$npm_package_version-firefox.zip -C dist/webext-prod .
scripts.zip:chromium: npm run build:chromium && tar -caf v$npm_package_version-chromium.zip -C dist/webext-prod .
